description: Needs sign-in (connect this server with OAuth, or pass an API key as the Authorization: Bearer header). Makes the desktop builds you uploaded to your own desktop-app listing live: the same step as Make it live on Manage → Desktop builds. Call it after upload-native.mjs when the creator asked you to publish or ship the build (their ask is the approval). Without build, the newest waiting build of every platform and processor goes live; with build (the id upload-native.mjs printed), only that one. A test build that answers a crowd request is not made live here: it goes live when the owner accepts it on its page.

build.description: Optional: one build's id, as upload-native.mjs printed it.

name: make_native_live
